summary: NAFDAC recalled substandard Astamocil (Amoxicillin 125mg/5ml suspension) batch 826024 and Astamentin (Amoxicillin/Clavulanic Acid 228.5mg/5ml) batches 0501724 and 0503024 by Sam-Ace Ltd, found in Kano. Both failed lab analysis for low API, risking treatment failure and resistance
